subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

An elephant is a __ large __mammal.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Tiny.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"large"** means something that is big in size, extent, or amount. (बड़ा)

 
 
• **Example: **An elephant is a large mammal that can weigh up to 6000 kilograms.
 
 
 
• **"Tiny"** refers to something that is very small in size. (छोटा)
 
 
• **Example: **The kitten was so tiny that it could fit in the palm of my hand.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'large' **is **'tiny'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Tiny**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Bumper **(विशाल): Exceptionally large or abundant.

 
 
• **Example:** We had a bumper crop this year, yielding more produce than ever before.
 
 
 
• **Gigantic **(विशालकाय): Extremely large in size.
 
 
• **Example: **The gigantic statue towered over the visitors in the park.
 
 
 
• **Heroic** (वीरता): Exhibiting or marked by courage and daring.
 
 
• **Example:** The firefighter's heroic actions saved many lives during the blaze.
